904428.name: VMax Cats – Relic Fusion I: The Awakening

blends.name: Relic Fusion I – The Awakening
blends.desc:
This fusion of **Relic I – Iron Key** and **Relic II – The Chest** unlocks a hidden power.
After blending, the collector gains access to the secret *#signal-transmission channel*, revealing Captain One-Eyed Joe’s lost maps and journal entries.
What’s in the chest? You’ll find out after blending.
